title: paraboea neurophylla

It is native to the tropical forests of Sri Lanka and has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its medicinal properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Paraboea neurophylla include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cognitive function, and protect against oxidative stress, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
